anchor_recoverability.false_correction_risk_note: 109 cells have a correct anchor and a disagreeing alternative (0.0264 of correct-anchor cells). An unconstrained override of every disagreement would convert these into new errors.

patterns.note: Only one eligible alternative expert, so two-alternative consensus patterns A-C are undefined and reported as 0.

confidence.note: Anchor wrong cells have lower top1 / margin and higher entropy than correct cells, but recoverable vs unrecoverable errors overlap substantially. A threshold on confidence alone is unlikely to isolate safe corrections without a second expert signal.

D1.note: D1 requires two alternatives; with one alternative it cannot change any cell.

D2.note: With one alternative, D2 replaces the anchor whenever that alternative disagrees.

D3.note: With two experts, disagreement is a tie and D3 keeps the anchor, matching D0.

unique_value.wyh_model_v2_unique_value_answer: Yes. WYH MODEL V2 is uniquely correct on 82 cells that LZH Prior-H misses, which is the entire incremental oracle of the eligible two-expert pool. That is meaningful unique value despite a lower standalone accuracy (0.8212 vs 0.8266). It is not enough, by itself, to create a 3-expert team oracle, and unconstrained replacement of the anchor by WYH is unsafe because WYH also introduces 109 false corrections.
